snippet.title: Quern - Undying Thoughts - Nintendo Switch Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Quern is an island filled with beautiful scenery, forgotten places, unusual machinery, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. 

The game's puzzles grow more demanding as players move deeper into the island. Observation and experimentation are just as important as logic, with each discovery opening up another part of the mystery. 

A decade after its Steam debut, Zadbox Entertainment's atmospheric first-person puzzle adventure arrives on Nintendo Switch on October 6th, 2026. 

Pre-Order Now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/quern-undying-thoughts-switch/
